out.title: Mitrankur Majumdar appointed Segment Head SURE, Senior Management Personnel
out.summary: Infosys appointed Mitrankur Majumdar as Segment Head for SURE and Senior Management Personnel effective August 24, 2026; incumbent Ashiss Kumar Dash transitions to CEO-designate duties.

person.name: Mitrankur Majumdar
person.role: Segment Head, SURE; Senior Management Personnel
person.bio: EVP with 30+ years at Infosys; previously Global Head of Services; leads AI partnerships and GCC practice; BE Electronics and MBA, UT Austin.
